social.og_description: WinProx is a QR-based facility platform: issues, tasks, a Time clock (included) with GPS work visits, ESG and IoT Connect. WinProx Checkmate is the stripped-down variant for cleaning & construction: check in and out on site with CIAO — in the browser, no app.

title: What is WinProx?
lead: WinProx is a QR-based facility platform for issues and tasks. WinProx Checkmate is the stripped-down variant for cleaning and construction crews: check in and out on site with GPS verification (100 m) and CIAO registration with the RSZ — €5 per worker per month, no issues or tasks.

what.title: Core idea
what.body: Every physical location or unit gets a digital QR portal. Citizens and staff report defects via the unit QR. Field workers sign in via the Clock Point QR, start and stop work on a location or unit pin (GPS work visits) and complete tasks on site. Managers follow everything in one workspace: issue → tasks → completion. One Facility app as the base; WinProx Checkmate is the derived, stripped-down product for pure on-site attendance.

audience.title: Who it is for
items: Cleaning and maintenance crews who work at customer sites
Construction and site crews who clock in, log work visits and finish tasks on site
Facility and maintenance teams who need to steer issues and tasks
Organisations with multiple locations, units or assets
Teams that register time/presence via Clock Point
Organisations that want ESG measurements tied to the same portals
Organisations that want sensors and gateways tied to the same issues and tasks (IoT Connect)
Organisations that only want to register attendance at customer sites — WinProx Checkmate (€5 per worker per month)

sectors.title: Sectors
items: Cleaning and maintenance at customer sites

items.name: Facility
items.text: Issues, public-portal moderation, tasks per team, calendar and briefing.

items.name: Checkmate
items.text: A derived plan for field work (cleaning & construction): workers clock in and out via the Clock Point QR, start and stop customer visits at the work address with GPS verification within 100 m, take breaks and view My hours — no issues, tasks or schedules. Managed via a reduced back office (customers, workers, hours); CIAO activation via self-service. €5 per worker per month.

items.name: Time
items.text: Clock in/out and breaks via Clock Point QR, GPS work visits on a location or unit pin, presence, timesheets, My hours and an optional per-team minimum break. Optional CIAO (RSZ Check In and Out) for cleaning; the construction scope is ready behind a feature flag until NSSO specs go live.

items.name: ESG
items.text: Optional measurements and indicators linked to units and follow-up tasks.

items.name: IoT Connect
items.text: Optional sensor gateways: alarms become issues and tasks; on Corporate also ESG measurements.

items.name: API & webhooks
items.text: REST API (Sanctum) and outbound webhooks on Corporate — for integrations.

tech.title: Technology
tech.body: Web application (Laravel + Livewire). Public QR portals work on phones without install. Multilingual (NL, EN, FR, DE, ES, IT) with optional AI translation of report text.

compliance.title: Privacy & compliance
items: GDPR-oriented design with public privacy and DPA documents
Photos and text on public QR pages stay blurred until approval
Tenant isolation: data per organisation, no product sector on the tenant
Optional CIAO transfer (NISS, presence) to the Belgian NSSO — only if you turn it on

languages.title: Languages
languages.body: Interface and marketing in Dutch, English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.
